column3: #2654 fixed: UpdateOwnProfile never sets IsActive, so UpdateUser takes its default branch, whose write is UpdateUserIfActiveStateMatches, a column-scoped conditional UPDATE (username/email/display_name/is_active/updated_at only, WHERE id=? AND is_active=? AND deleted_at IS NULL, matched=false fails closed with ErrUserActiveStateConflict) built from a tx.LockUserForUpdate re-read with only the request's changes applied. It writes no password_hash/account_state/MFA/lockout column (#2785) and no longer writes back a stale email/username (FIX-USER-ROW-NARROW-1). An email equal to the row the re-auth decision read is dropped from the request, so an email change committing between that read and UpdateUser's own read cannot turn the web page's resent email into an email change that skipped re-auth.
